svg.title: Inside and outside the ODD
svg.desc: Three panels of the robotaxi on a city street. Speed: a 30 mph sign inside the geofence and a 35 mph sign beyond it. Rain. Fog. Under each, the inside and outside of the attribute as WP-C-02 states it, and the monitor that detects it.

g.text: Roads posted at or below 30 mph (48 km/h)
Roads posted higher, including the 35 mph arterials
Detected by MON-01 (Map and route check) · Proposed
Dry; light rain up to 2.5 mm/h
Rain above 2.5 mm/h; snow, sleet, hail
Detected by MON-03 (Weather and visibility) · Decided (DQ-012 A)
Meteorological visibility of 200 m or more
Fog, mist, smoke, dust or spray below 200 m
Detected by MON-03 (Weather and visibility) · Decided (DQ-012 A)
Anything the vehicle cannot handle must be outside the ODD, or it must notice and reach a minimal risk condition by itself.
